TaaSFlow Network · By introduction

# A quieter way to be considered for the right work.

TaaSFlow Network is a curated space for highly skilled people — senior operators, specialists and internationally mobile talent. Express interest in selective briefs, or stay privately discoverable for premium opportunities worldwide.

[Join the network](/candidate/join)
[Browse roles](/jobs)

Membership is free for professionals. Your profile is never visible to clients without your consent.

Who this is for

## Built for people who don’t need another job board.

TaaSFlow Network is most useful if you’re a senior operator, a deep specialist, or a professional considering an international move. The members we work best with already have options — they want fewer, better conversations.

- Senior individual contributors
- Founders, principals & heads of
- Specialists with rare technical depth
- Internationally mobile professionals
- Quietly exploring, not actively searching
- Open to relocation in selected markets

How it works

## Three ways to be considered.

You decide how visible you want to be — and to whom.

Open brief

### Express interest in a role

Review the brief, then express interest. We review every submission individually and reply with a clear next step.

[Browse briefs](/jobs)
Network membership

### Join the network

Create a member profile to be considered for future briefs that match your direction. No public listings, no algorithmic noise.

[Join the network](/candidate/join)
By introduction

### Be quietly discoverable

Opt in to be surfaced — privately — to selected subscription clients for premium opportunities. Always under your control.

[Learn about privacy](/privacy)
Why this isn’t a job board

## Fewer roles. Higher signal. Considered work for considered people.

Traditional job boards optimise for volume. We optimise for relevance. Every brief on the network has a real client behind it, a real budget, and a real timeline — and every member is reviewed by a person, not a filter.

Standard job board
- Public listings
- Auto-rejections
- Mass outreach
- Profile is a commodity

TaaSFlow Network
- Curated briefs
- Human review
- Private introductions
- Profile stays yours

Privacy & control

## Your career, on your terms.

Discretion is part of the product. Your profile is never indexed publicly, never sold, and never shown to a client without your consent for that specific brief.

Never publicly indexed

Your profile is invisible to search engines. Members only.

Consent per introduction

We ask before sharing your details with any specific client.

You stay in control

Pause visibility, edit details, or leave the network at any time.

Current employer safe

Hide your profile from named companies you don’t want to see it.

Global opportunities

## Work that crosses borders.

Many of our briefs are remote-first or open to international candidates. Where relocation or visa support is on the table, the brief will say so explicitly — and the client commits to it before we make the introduction.

### Remote-first by default

Most briefs are open to professionals across multiple regions.

### Regional specialisation

Focus on EMEA, APAC and the Americas — local context matters.

### Relocation, when offered

Visa and relocation support is brief-specific. Never assumed, never promised on our behalf.

Premium briefs · Premium network

## The other side of the network.

TaaSFlow works with subscription clients — funded scale-ups, global enterprises, and specialist firms — who pay to access a curated network rather than scroll through CVs. When you opt in to be discoverable, you’re shown only to those clients, only for briefs that match your direction, and only with your consent at the moment of introduction.

[Join the network](/candidate/join)
[How it works](/how-it-works)

### See an open brief?

Review live briefs and express interest in the ones that fit. We reply individually.

[Browse open briefs](/jobs)

### Not actively looking?

Join the network privately. We’ll only be in touch when something genuinely fits.

[Join the network](/candidate/join)
